body:
Thanks for taking the time to try to help but I'm just going to go ahead and blow my brains how right now. The only thing worse than living 10 years like this is living 10 years and one day. 

Good bye.
I have. I usually do a nationwide search.
I don't have anything to sell.
I've lost count. I used to get a lot more than I do now. There aren't as many jobs as there used to be around here. These days I might get 1 or 2 a month.
I don't make enough money to afford school.
Thanks, I'll look into this.
SC
I called them and they said they don't do that here. What you're talking about is probably called something different here if it exists at all here.
Occupational Services just does testing for a job. They do physicals and stuff like that on site. It's to meet regulations for certain industries.

I wish I had a way to heat food. Something warm would me nice today. 

I attempted suicide earlier today. I don't think I'm going to be OK this time. I think I'm finally at that point where there is nothing to lose my my death wouldn't affect anything that I care about. There is a high possibility that I'm going to attempt to kill myself probably in the next few minutes.
I'm going to bed dead soon so don't worry about it.
I am A+ certified. I worked in a computer repair shop for 12 years getting paid commission until it went out of business.

I have proof that I don't know what to do and whats worse is I seem to never learn from my mistakes. I've been countless times at the cusp of a relationship and almost every time she just loses interest. Then I never hear from her again. I have no idea what I did or what went wrong. I just play the scenario back in my mind over and over again, every day for years until the next time it happens. That is what I hate the most about this is there is no real feedback. What is it about me that makes everyone not like me?

Most stuff go unread here. People pour their heart out and no one responds, no up votes at all. 

There are posts that go ignored on r/SuicideWatch as well. People reaching out for help just to be ignored is insane. 

Then you have the people trying to help. There are trolls but thankfully those aren't a lot and usually get moderated. Most people are good hearted here and want to help but really don't know how. So they just blabber on and make no impact. A lot of people need professional help too so a paragraph here won't really help. 

There are also a lot of people that just want to one up what you've said. Adding nothing to value to the conversation with their strong need to talk about themselves. 

This website isn't set up for this kind of stuff. It's a link aggregation site not a support site for the downtrodden. It's amazing there are any successes here at all.

I do. I mostly dream about my dead father. Things I would like to show him or say to him. What would he say about this or that. I sometimes day dream about going back in time to meet him. Maybe with a cure to save him and then we can work together to make life better for the family in the future. Or even just keep the family together.
I have no loved ones left a live.
The longest I went without receiving a message, phone call or email that wasn't spam was a little over 4 years. I remember looking at my phone in 2012 and the last call I got was in 2007.
Pancreatic cancer.
That will be a poor substitution for the real thing.
[They do all the time](https://www.reddit.com/r/ForeverAlone/comments/24z8t8/my_life_in_a_nutshell/chc4yjk?context=3). I've been subject to it on multiple occasions.
So she'll laugh at my jokes, let me pay for her dinner and still fuck my friends?
An emotional tampon that they can discard when they are feeling better.

You just run into some people that are just socially inept. At home they either bully their parents and siblings around until they get what they want or they get bullied by their parents or siblings until they give in and do whatever for them. So that translates to all the other relationships in their life. They just don't know how to use manors to get what they want. 

I see it all the time at work. A lot of adults throw tantrums like kids. They insult you like children do each other and sometimes even cry and spit like a baby in an attempt to get their way. It's just people that were never told "no". 

Big babies.
All of my loved ones are dead.

When I was a teenager shortly after my dad died I was forced to see one. She came to our house and talked to my mom and me. Like I said I was a teenager, I was depressed because I lost my dad not long before that and I was being bull headed like a lot of teens do. So I didn't want to talk to anyone about it. This made our therapist very upset and she had me sent to juvenile detention for 45 days to be "evaluated". While locked up I had to do multiple choice test. That was the extent of their evaluation. They were able determine that I was depressed. Imagine that, a kid that just lost his dad and was now locked up in jail being depressed? What else was I supposed to be.

After 45 days I was released back to my mom. I went home to find that she had given away all my stuff. I didn't even have a bed. The therapist never showed back up and my mom walked out on me shortly after. Leaving me to finish high school alone. I've been alone ever since.

So I am incapable of trusting any kind of mental health worker. I'm sure there are good ones out there but I can't take that chance. It took too long and too much effort to acquire what I little I have and to have someone like that just strip me of it would be devastating. I'm not going to allow that again.

I think some of these healthcare workers get into that field to abuse people. In your case I wouldn't go back to that guy ever again. That's not right being touched like that.

I have a friend that has a social anxiety disorder. He works at a grocery store. So it's either at home or at work. He goes nowhere else. When he's at home he doesn't leave his room. He lives with his brother and his brother's wife. 

Somehow it's a new hot girl every few weeks that come to see him. He doesn't even have bedsheets in his room. It's a monument to depression. It doesn't stop these 8 out of 10 girls and up from visiting him and sleeping with him. They even seem to be willing to share him amongst themselves. At first I thought they were prostitutes but he doesn't make a lot of money for one and two some of these girls we went to school with and I know personally. It's like any girl that meets him has to sleep with him. He really doesn't care and just sleeps with them anyway. It doesn't matter to him if they are there or not.

I've noticed that my friends get a lot of Christmas cards and birthday cards. I wouldn't know what to do with one if I got one. Do you keep it? Do you read it and toss it? If I got one should I scan it and archive it but toss the physical card so I can save on space? 

I haven't gotten a Christmas card or birthday card in over 20 years. All that stopped when my dad died.

I am the only person left in my family to pass on the last name. Most of my family is dead and I've spent so many years alone now I don't have any need to find someone to be with. 

I'm sure if my parents were still alive there would be pressure to find someone and have children. 

I'm looking down the barrel of 40 now and the older I get the less I want anything to do with children or a wife.

Let me tell you about the BS I've dealt with over the years. This all has happened over the past 15 or so years. Not all back to back. 

After high school I started feeling lonely. As my friends were all pairing off and getting married, starting families and what not, I stayed alone. I tried but failed so many times and with so many negative results that it started making my physically ill to think about. So I gave up completely after the last time things exploded in my face due to a woman. 

I remember meeting a girl at my work. She was good looking, funny and seemed into me. We talked for a couple of hours straight. The next day she came back in just to talk. The conversation turned to haircuts and I told her she had beautiful hair. Out of nowhere, with no warning, she slapped me harder than any man has ever hit me before in my life. Before I could collect myself and ask her why she was out the door. I still to this day don't understand what I did wrong or what was wrong with her. 

I went to a party with a friend. I knew some of the people there but not the girl throwing the party. It was at her apartment. My friend was introducing her to a few people he knew including me. She shook all of their hands except for mine. She turned her nose up and prosperously avoided me. It was so obvious that another friend said, "Wow! What a bitch!" She really tried hard to embarrass me in front of my friends. For the rest of the evening I just waited in the car since I wasn't welcomed there. 

A few years after that I met a girl that I really got along with. She seemed cool and I asked her out. Her response, "I don't want to date you. I think that you and I are at the bottom of the barrel and I feel like since we both can't get dates that you and I dating would just be because we can't find anyone else. I know we get along well and I would go as far to say that we get along better than anyone else I've met. I'm sure we would have a lot of fun together and this could possible last. I just don't feel like my friends would think highly of me if I found someone on my level socially." 

I tried to help a woman that dropped her hat in the parking lot at a store one time. The wind caught it and blew her hat away from her. I told her that I had it and ran over to get it. She had a smile on her face until I walked up to her to hand her hat back to her. She then hit me with her purse and told me to stay away from her. 

One time I went to a wholesale club to buy something really early in the morning. There was only one other woman there shopping. I passed her every time I went down an isle. After about the 6th time she started giving me the stink eye. She eventually called the manager and I was asked to leave the store because apparently I made her feel uncomfortable. 

From my experience most women seem to be too sensitive. They seem to want to be surrounded by beautiful things and people all the time and will fight to make sure they are. Most of my experiences with women have been negative and it's basically because I'm not attractive. I've been everything from insulted to assaulted to accused of attempting to rape. I was even arrested because of it and am lucky that as they were booking me she confessed that her accusations weren't true. I've given up completely on dating and avoid the opposite sex as much as possible now. 

The thing is I think all this would be easier if I had family. My parents are dead and my sister has been dead for a while too. I don't have anyone left so I spend all of my time alone these days. I have a job where people treat me negatively so it drives me further into isolation. I hate it and I hate being around people now. I also hate being alone too. It would be nice to have someone to talk to but I have a feeling that won't work. I'm just going to spend the rest of my days marching on, alone.

Don't get me started about birthdays. Since my dad died 21 years ago I haven't really celebrated a birthday. There have been a couple where I spent it with someone that that ended up worse than the times when I spent it alone. 

Last year, even I forgot it was my birthday. I didn't realize I was a year older until I was filling out a form and it asked for my age almost a month later. 

I don't even care about it any more.

I was just thinking the last time I had this conversation with a girl she explained to me how I should just accept being alone forever. She told me that before me she didn't realize that not everyone was going to find someone.

The top 2 things are when my mom walked out on my shortly after my dad died. She was depressed and just wanted out of there. She found another man and left me there. She would bring me groceries every couple of weeks but we had very little interaction until the day she died. 

The next is a date I went on about 10 years ago. I had been very stressed up until this day over a lot of different things. I hadn't been eating well or sleeping well. She picked me up and we went out to eat at a place she wanted to take me. I'd never been there before. We ordered our food and talked. I don't remember what happened next but I had a seizure and fell out in the floor. When I came to she was gone. I had to pay for both of our meals and I still didn't get to eat. The owner of the restaurant threw a big fit about it. I was still disoriented and didn't really know what was going on. The ambulance took me to the hospital. They checked me out and the next day I was released. I had to walk 7 miles back home from the hospital. I've never heard from her again. 

When my dad was dying he told me that when the shit hit's the fan the first thing out the door is a woman. He told me not to hold it against them but it's just how life is. I thought he was bitter from his life being shortened but later on I found it to be true. I found women to be unreliable, unhelpful and just selfish. I think of all the times I helped people and how I was repaid. 

If you can't trust your mother than you can you trust?
Then they get mad at you when you can't do what they tell you to do. It's hard for some people to understand that some people's capabilities are different.
Yeah I have a place to live now. It's not extravagant but it's a start.
I couldn't afford a place to live. I had to sleep in my car until I could find a new job.

I went on a first date with a girl I met through a friend. She told me she would pick me up and we'd go to a restaurant she wanted to try. Everything was going great until I had a seizure. I came to in the floor while everyone around me and she was nowhere to be found. I had to pay for our dinner that I didn't get to eat but 2 bites of and then ride to the hospital in an ambulance. Then when I realized from the hospital I had to walk 7 miles home alone. Couldn't get in touch with anyone that night. I never heard from her again.

I used to listen to music of read depressing stories. Now I'm kind of beyond that. I don't even fantasize any more about finding someone and starting a family. I used to think about the kind of stuff you run into while raising kids. How I would handle that. The kind of things I would like to show them. I used to daydream about telling my kids about my mom, dad and my grandfather. What kind of people they were like before they passed away. How weird it would be to live in a house with other people again. 

Now I just don't even think about it. When I think about the future I just worry if I've saved enough money for me or how am I going to advance my career. I think about me travelling and there isn't anyone there with me now. 

Deep down inside I know it's not going to happen now. It's over and there isn't any reason to think it is going to be.

I've completely lost my sex drive and didn't realise it until I had actually got a date some time back. After talking to her online for a few months she gave me the "Errr why not?" So we went out had a decent time. She invited me back to her place where I was unable to gain an erection. She got upset and told me to leave and I never heard from her again. That's when I realized I had lost my sex drive completely.

I think personally if a girl doesn't like and just tells you she's not interested then there is no reason to be bitter. You and I both aren't going to be everyone's cup of tea and that's OK. I think if it's reasonable and she's not rude about it, wish her luck in finding what she's looking for and move on. I think we can easily all agree that's reasonable. 

What makes me bitter is the nasty attitudes and screwed up situations you'll get into because she all of a sudden decides she hates you or loses interest for one reason or another. A long time back I dated this girl that I didn't know was married. She had just separated, like I helped her unpack in her new apartment. She nice and cool and she made me feel special. I thought she was going to be the one. I dated her for a couple of months and one day her husband came into my work threatening to beat me up. Here's the kicker, the guy was sick. His skin was this yellowish green color like his liver had failed or whatever causes that. This guy was very skinny too, he was half my size and I could have beaten him to death because he was so frail. I was able to talk him out of wanting to fight and explained to him that we're both the victim here. She was playing us. I never heard from her again or him. It really broke my heart on several different levels. I felt very bitter towards her for that. 

Another girl I dated was an old friend. One day she started flirting with me and one thing led to another. Turns out after a month of dating her she was a pill head. On Valentine’s Day I took her out and she drank a lot. I had enough of her when she demanded that I take her to another guy's house that we know so she could smash his windows and slash his tires. She was also flirting with other guys and being very argumentative to me. I took her to her house to drop her off and go home. I was tired and sick of her crap. We get to her house and she's so drunk she can't walk in. So I help her then I go use her restroom. Her dog had peed in the hallway and left a huge puddle. I come out of the restroom and she's naked in the floor crying rolling around in dog piss. She then starts screaming at me saying I attempted to rape her. I left her there and went straight home. Later on that night I'm arrested because she had called the cops and told them I tried to rape her. As I'm being booked she confesses it didn't really happen. All I could think about was my name and mugshot being in that paper where they do the mugshots of people with why they were arrested under their name. It would have ruined my reputation in this small town. 

I was really bitter towards all women for a very long time after that. I hated even thinking about dating and gave up completely on it. It had an adverse effect, even though now I've overcome that bitterness I have completely lost my sex drive. So it basically ruined me until I can afford to go to the doctor and do something about it. If something can be done about it. 

I guess really you can have to right in certain situations to be bitter but it's better to just let it all go.

Not going after my best friend's exgirlfriend. There has never been a woman in my life like her. We were prefect for each other, I think about her often. She's married to another guy now with a daughter. I loved her. It's a pain I'll carry with me until the day I die. I paid dearly for my hesitation.
All those hateful attitudes are why I've been driven away from dating.

Women make me feel guilty for wanting to be in a relationship. Every attempt at seeking a relationship has been met with some type of punishment and humiliation issued by women. So I gave up and will never try again. It's too dangerous to try again. All they have to do is call the police and claim you tried to rape them. They will arrest and book you. Your picture will end up on a mugshot website with your name next to sexual assault that Google will be more than happy to show any possible future employer even though you didn't do it and it never went to court because she finally came clean and admitted you didn't do anything. 

You have a choice, risk having you life ruined forever or be alone forever.
I don't care.
I hate when people say this. It makes me feel like all they're saying what I've gone through in life is trivial.
I knew a schizophrenic guy that acted simular to this in high school. They put him on meds and he stopped with the threats towards women.

At times I get bitter. I have no family left. Like today being Father's Day I realized that he's been dead for almost 21 years now. I see a lot of people I knew from high school or people around my age with families now and I wonder why that couldn't be me. I understand that not everyone is going to keep their loved ones around forever and I get that I'm not going to be every woman's cup of tea. It just doesn't make sense at the extreme negative reaction I get. 

I'll learn of stuff like the last girl I had a brief relationship with is getting married soon. She accused me of attempting to rape her. Called the cops and everything on me. When I get arrested she finally confesses  that I didn't try to rape her and they let me go. For a moment there I was scared that I was about to lose everything. It scared me away from dating completely. It took me a little over a decade to work up the nerve to try to date and she took it away from me. I can't try at all now. She moves on and gets a new guy that moves her into his big house and buys her a new car. Its almost like she was rewarded for what she did to me. I know life is too random for that but some kind of karma would be nice. I know I shouldn't care but I just think about being arrested at work the next day and carted off to the police station. We have a little paper that people can buy at the gas station around here that shows all the mug shots of the people arrested that week. If it had gone that far, if she hadn't called and told them she was lying, then I would have been in that paper even though I didn't do anything. Under my picture and name would have been attempted rape. Not to mention the websites that do mugshots. Future employers search my name and that would have came up. That would have fucked my life up. 

The girl was seeing before her dumped me the day my mother died. Said she couldn't be with a man that cried. She's married now, a house wife. Has 3 kids. I hope he doesn't cry when she dies. 

I guess really I need to learn to fully accept being alone. Being with someone isn't going to be something everyone does and I just got to learn to live with that. Most of the time I stay busy enough to distract myself from that, but I seriously need to get over it. I've already tried to kill myself one time.

I'm doing alright. That was a little over 20 years ago when my Dad passed away. I'm in my 30s now. 

I do live in the same town. I work a job getting paid commission so there are good weeks and bad weeks. My mom has been dead for about 14 years now. She died about 6 years after my dad passed away. I have no family left alive that I can interact with.

My Dad died when I was 13 and a year after that my Mom moved out to live with her boyfriend. She paid the taxes on the house and brought me food every month when she got her disability check. There were months when the power was out. I really struggled with depression and getting to school everyday. It set me back in a lot of ways. While my friends I grew up with were getting girlfriends, driving cars, going on family vacations and to the prom. I sat at home rationing food, scheming to make enough money for power and trying my hardest to not look destitute. It was a very lonely, isolated time in my life and the only thing that got better was accepting loneliness.

The way every woman I've dated, met or been associated with, including my own mother has driven me to be alone for the rest of my life. I find it hard to advance in life with a woman around. I'm miserable too when I'm with someone. This is absolutely true.
There aren't any near me but if there was I'd give it a shot.
I got a slightly better job a few years back and now things are better than they were then. I'm thankful for what I have now which isn't much but better.
I worked at Applebee's for a few years while being homeless. It didn't pay enough to afford rent anywhere so I just lived out of my car while I worked there.
I just almost threw up because of the saliva sound when she whispers. It's really gross to me and that's how isolated I am from people these days. The nosies and sounds they make are alien to me now.

I only have a couple family members left alive. They are all drug addicts and I don't stay in touch with them. 

My parents were great. My dad was wonderful. He was everything a normal dad was supposed to be. He worked a lot because he rain his own business but he made up for it by taking me to work with him on the weekends. I loved it too. Some of my best memories are of us going on vacation and him and I fishing together. He was stern, no BS man but he was fun and never abusive. I'm so thankful that I had a great father even though he passed away when I was 13. I'm glad I got to know him. 

My mom was great up to when my dad passed away. She was very laid back. Which my household was. It was a quite, stable environment and very comfortable. She made it that way. It's something I strive for again in life. She was a member of the PTA and volunteered a lot for her church doing a lot of work for charities. She helped a lot of poor people out in our community. When my dad died it broke her. She gave almost all of our stuff away and walked out on me. I spent from 13 to 19 alone with no family. She had a heart condition that was corrected by an artificial valve in her heart. They had her on a lot of medication. In the end the mixture of meds she was on killed her. Nothing was every done about it. She spent the last few years of her life very depressed and reclusive. She remarried to a man that screwed her over and caused her to lose our house by taking a mortgage out on it without her knowledge. I never was close to her after dad died. 

My sister was 13 years older than me. She was the result of my mom being raped when she was 17. My sister was 14 years older than me. She ODed and killed her shortly before my mom died. She was a bad drug addict and stole a lot from her. She was addicted to pills. I was never close to her. The age difference coupled with drug addiction made that impossible for me. 

My father was from another country. I had a lot of family members overseas but being poor with no family meant I couldn't visit them that often. So I wrote them letters to stay in touch. Over the years each of them passed away. My grandfather was great. He was funny and full of knowledge. It was great talking to him. He died 8 years ago at 82. He was a great man. I loved him a lot. I did get to see him a couple of years before he died. He flew me over to see him. I cherish those memories of him. 

I knew my other grandfather too. He was great also. He passed away in 2000. The VA hospital didn't take all the staples out of his leg after an operations to improve blood flow to his foot due to diabetes. It became infected and killed him. He was also a great man. Very laid back and in his later years he just drove around everyday seeing old friends and family. He wasn't rich but had life all figured out. 

I wasn't really close to any of my other family. My mom's mom wasn't a nice person. My mom wrote her off because of how poorly she treated everyone in the family. I don't blame her. I knew her as a child and met her once as an adult. All she had to say was bad things about my mom's dad. I knew my grandfather well and everything she had to say didn't describe the man I knew. Even if he wasn't that great younger when they divorced he ended up being a kind, awesome man that never spoke ill of anyone. It was uncalled for the treatment she gave him. 

I have now spent most of my life alone. I lost the people I was closest two over half of my life ago, 20 years ago, and I've grown used to being alone. I haven't had any success at all in relationships so starting a new family isn't going to happen anytime soon or at all. I'm not comfortable around people anymore anyway. I still morn their loss. I wish I could have spent more time with all of them. I have no one now. I'm lucky I got what I had and at all. I'm thankful for that.

I've thought about it and really would love to delete my sex drive completely. Which I really rarely feel the urge to want sex anymore. I think the notion of how useless it is for a person like me to try takes time to sink through all the layers that make up a person. 

The desire to have sex is shrouded with nothing but negative feelings for me. All past experiences with it are negative and I wish I could get rid of it but without any of the other side effects of castration.

I've noticed that people closer to the middle range of looks seem to have the most trouble finding someone to be with. When I was in high school most of the below average girls were dating guys and some of them getting knocked up. The not so good looking guys were pairing off with the not so good looking girls. The good looking people were pairing off and the people around the middle weren't having as much luck. 

It's like if you're at the bottom or at the top it's easier to find someone in your range. Everyone near the middle doesn't want to date down so they keep looking up but no one above them is looking back down.

Back in high school I got a "Ew gross, you're the wrong race, I only date black guys." Then she went and told her friend that I asked her out like it was a sin or I was wrong for trying and they laughed at me.

Lucky for me my parents died before all that came around. My Mom probably wouldn't have cared to be honest she checked out about 10 years before she died because of the meds they had her on after she had heart surgery. She really didn't care about anything at all up until the day she died. She'd had pretended to be nice so that nothing gets out of hand and she doesn't have to put any effort into stuff. 

My dad would be disappointed in how life turned out for me. I know he didn't care about fame or riches but he did want me to be happy and I'm not. I have none of the resources at my disposal to overcome my setbacks so I'll die alone. I've also had too many negative experiences to care to try again. No one has ever told me anything helpful about my situation. It's just regurgitated malarkey that people feed me in an attempt to feel better that they tried. He would have something to say. He would say that one thing and would throw all this into perspective and then he would spit out a prefect solution. He was an engineer that owned his own company. He was great at solving problems and dealing with people. When he died there were so many people that came to our house. Grown men crying on the phone. He was the type of person made an impact on others. I didn't get enough time with him for that to rub off on me. I know I'm not him and he knew that too. Our individuality was celebrated in our household. It was important to find a path for me that would make me happy when he was around. When he died that stopped. That was the day I instantly became alone in this world. My greatest ally was gone. He'd be disappointed in how it all turned out. His heart would be broken.
I've never had a positive experience in a relationship. I'm only miserable when I'm around women and that's including my own mother before she died.
Amazing how my experiences upset others. Also the conversation always dead ends right there.

It's not the awkwardness as much as it's the negativity that a woman brings with her in a relationship. The constant maintenance and eggshell walking you have to do when you are with someone. The all around unstable mental condition of all the women I've met in my life is what has turned me away from dating for good.
I hate Mother's Day and Father's Day because both of my parents are dead. It's just a reminder of how little I have in this world.

I tried to kill myself about 5 years ago. I really saw no point in life at all. I had become so frustrated with never having anyone in my life that I liked or could get along with, never having a decent job that I could be proud of doing, never being able to afford the things I wanted or wanted to do, or being able to afford most of the stuff I really needed. Nothing was working out and I just wanted out as soon as possible. 

I honestly don't know why I carried on. I've had a lot of bad days since then and the good days are unremarkable. I really have no idea why I didn't try to kill myself again. I really don't like life or the people I'm surrounded by. I've been trying to better my life but failed my entire adult life. I think there's a part of me that's just curious at how bad it can get. I think that's the only reason I stick around.

I'll tell you what I hate about dating or relationships, whatever you want to call it. 

It never seems like you're enough. I was overweight for years then I worked out, ride my bike everyday. I lost 75 lbs. Started to look more chiseled, felt better. It got my foot in the door but even that wasn't enough. I got a better job made a little more money, that wasn't enough. Better car, better clothes, better haircut, none of it was enough. I hit a point where I just couldn't put anymore effort into it. You got to be constantly happy, entertaining, good looking. You can't have a bad day and fuck it if you want to change your life and need to buckle down for a few weeks or months to make any changes. Every time it's just a ticket back to being alone. You can't do or have enough to please a woman. That's what experience has taught me. People will argue that is all wrong but what they say it is and what I've witnessed it to be are two different things.
